svg.title: Minecraft Maze - Floor 1 - Seed: Maze13
svg.text: Transitions: 5 elevators; 3 drops; 2 optional decoy routes
E1: elevator up 1 floor to Floor 2
D1: optional drop landing from Floor 2 (1 floor)
E2: elevator up 1 floor to Floor 2
E5: optional decoy elevator up 2 floors to Floor 3
D3: optional decoy drop landing from Floor 3 (2 floors)
